cues: On the surface it is simple fact: the sun will be back in the morning.
Underneath, it answers the first stanza's all poor creatures born to die.
If good night to the sun is only a short parting, perhaps death is too.
The poem never says so; it lets a cheerful, throwaway phrase carry a hope it is too modest to state.
text: That phrase does two jobs. On the surface it is simple fact: the sun will be back in the morning. Underneath, it answers the first stanza's all poor creatures born to die. If good night to the sun is only a short parting, perhaps death is too. The poem never says so; it lets a cheerful, throwaway phrase carry a hope it is too modest to state.
